extracted.intended_audience: general readers of humorous travel literature (readers of Mark Twain, 19th-century anglophone readers)
extracted.subtask_description: A first-person, comic travel narrative that recounts foreign scenes and encounters with satirical observation, anecdote, and ironic contrast between expectation and reality. The page is an excerpt of Mark Twain's Innocents Abroad and serves as an exemplar of the genre rather than an explicit how-to.
